meta.title: Code Toolkit
meta.description: Four commands: three isolated checks — code review behind an eight-gate filter, behavior-preserving simplification that plans by default, and privacy scrubbing that reports masked findings and only rewrites with --apply — plus a caption loop that installs an explicit observe/verify/record cycle into the current session and keeps a ledger of every step. Prompts are organised as a layered skill-style tree, with a deterministic test suite and a model evaluation loop.
